search_query: What version of YAML is in Kubernetes 1.31?
reachability_classification: Production Reachable (API server admission & kubelet control loop)
direct_answer_summary: Kubernetes v1.31.0 utilizes sigs.k8s.io/yaml v1.4.0 as its primary JSON/YAML transcoder across the API server, kubectl, and kubelet. It enforces YAML 1.2 rules via JSON transcoding while pinning gopkg.in/yaml.v3 v3.0.1 for strict duplicate key rejection.
